label: Kota Kinabalu
short_description: The Sabah waterfront and city center on Borneo's coast.
intro: Kota Kinabalu's hotels in this directory cluster along the waterfront and city center of Sabah's capital on the northwest coast of Borneo -- a base known for sunset bays, seafood markets, and easy access to offshore island parks, Mount Kinabalu and diving. Properties range from waterfront towers with sea-view rooms and rooftop bars to a boutique design hotel, all a short drive from Kota Kinabalu International Airport (BKI).
